text:
jamie: Ok team, after yet another croissant disappearing, I hereby propose the 'Pegasus Pastry Protocol' (PPP). Steps: 1) Put a sticker on any pastry you bring 2) If you remove a sticker you owe 1 coffee 3) Sacred croissant goes in labelled box. Vote? :wing: :croissant:

matt: love it. sticker template? :grin:

sara: can stickers be holographic? :eyes:

jamie: basic sticker format: `PEG-<initials>-<YYYYMMDD>` — use sharpie on underside. keeps it low friction.

priya: @jamie genius. Also nominate a Pastry Warden? I'm volunteering as interim.

alex: @priya don't you have a toddler at home to train for that role :joy:

kitchen-bot: Reminder: labeled items left >48h will be donated to the breakroom pigeons. :bird:

matt: can we add a penalty of singing the office anthem if you take unlabeled pastry? :microphone:

jamie: yes, and record for posterity. designated anthem: 'Ballad of the Bagel' (link: https://example.com/anthem) :notes:

sara: poll time: do we adopt PPP? 1) Yes, full protocol 2) Yes, but no singing 3) No, chaos forever

alex: 1

matt: 1

priya: 2 — I will sing but only after coffee

jamie: 1 — also adding a 'pegasus' sticker roll in the kitchen drawer (next to tape)

dev-bot: Deploy success: added label printer to infra. just kidding. :robot_face:

sara: can we get one of those little pastry display domes labelled 'sacred croissant' pls

milo: :thumbsup:

jamie: Petition for a Pastry Warden badge: make it gold. :medal:

kitchen-bot: ACTION: Peggy (fridge sensor) detected temperature spike, croissant preservation status: nominal.

priya: timeline: start PPP tomorrow morning? I will put stickers and a tiny instruction card.

alex: brilliant. May the Pegasus watch over our carbs. :unicorn_face:
